name: Kausal Media
tagline: Investigasi Kausalitas, Anatomi Kekuasaan, dan Sejarah Tersembunyi
description: Indonesian investigative video essay channel combining ancient manuscript textures (papyrus, lontar, aged parchment) with traditional batik linework (Parang Rusak, Kawung, Mega Mendung). Dedicated to intellectual curiosity, causality, and empirical evidence.

aestheticVibe.theme: Ancient Scribe & Indonesian Cultural Archive (Light Mode)
culturalReferences: Batik Parang Rusak (Continuous diagonal wave symbolizing relentless momentum)
Batik Kawung (Four-lobed geometric balance symbolizing ethical restraint)
Cap Segel Notariat Hindia Belanda & Prasasti Kuno (Archival seals)
Sumi Ink Brushstrokes & Iron Gall Pigments

artStyleSpecification.name: European Comic Ligne Claire (Modern Jakarta Grounded)
artStyleSpecification.promptPrefix: Crisp isolated spot illustration in vintage European comic ligne claire art style, Herge and Tintin aesthetic, clean crisp uniform black ink contour outlines, flat warm color wash fill, modern day Jakarta context, authentic Indonesian elements
artStyleSpecification.negativePrompt: complex background, landscape, street view, horizon, clouds, trees, crowds, multiple unrelated objects, speech bubbles, modern text, 3D CGI, photorealistic
artStyleSpecification.motionLoopTreatment: cinematic subtle motion parallax, slow horizontal camera drift, atmospheric dust motes on aged papyrus, light mode

culturalGrounding.vehicles: Indonesian popular vehicles (Toyota Avanza, Innova, Daihatsu Xenia, Honda Brio, Honda Beat/Vario motorcycle, Blue Bird taxi)
culturalGrounding.establishments: Authentic Indonesian commercial setups (manual hydraulic carwash with single-post lift and pressure wand, warung kopi, ruko minimalis)
culturalGrounding.characters: Waist-up / bust framing by default (focus on facial expression, hands, props, modern batik kemeja, and ID lanyard; no full-body unless strictly relevant), natural organic bottom crop, zero caricature
culturalGrounding.composition: Isolated spotlight exhibits on clean light ivory parchment for rapid <100ms visual latch
culturalGrounding.framingBorder: Signature Kausal Media double-hairline border with corner rosettes on every video
culturalGrounding.pacingAndCuts: Macro cut / visual change every 2.5–4.5s; micro-events (push-in, zoom, pan) every 1.5–2s

videoDuration.clippableShortsArchitecture: Structured into 6–8 self-contained 45–60s micro-acts, each with independent hook, forensic proof, and payoff for 9:16 vertical Shorts/TikTok clipping

scriptDifferentiation.overview: YouTube algorithms penalize repetitive formulaic scripts, predictable sentence lengths, generic AI tropes, and flat synthetic voiceprints. Kausal Media enforces human investigative prose with asymmetrical cadence and forensic evidence.

rotation.technique: Open immediately in media res on a baffling economic or historical paradox without introductory throat-clearing.
rotation.example: Di saat cadangan devisa negara menipis pada musim kemarau 1928, satu sindikat perkebunan justru mencetak surplus delapan puluh ton perak tanpa membayar sesen pun pajak.

rotation.technique: Start by presenting an exact document, ledger, notary seal, or court docket.
rotation.example: Kertas segel bertarikh 14 Mei ini membuktikan bahwa separuh dari konsesi tambang tersebut sudah dialihkan sebelum undang-undangnya disahkan di parlemen.

rotation.technique: Dismantle a popular belief with an empirical contradiction in sentence one.
rotation.example: Banyak orang mengira krisis ini dipicu oleh kepanikan nasabah kecil. Data kliring membuktikan: pelarian modal justru dipimpin oleh lima rekening institusi pelat merah.

rotation.technique: State the fatal end result before tracing the chain reaction backward.
rotation.example: Dua ratus ribu hektar hutan lindung lenyap bukan karena pembalak liar, melainkan akibat satu pasal selundupan sepanjang delapan kata di lembar lampiran.

voiceAndCadenceEngineering.sentenceLengthVariation: Strictly alternate between punchy 3–5 word statements ('Uangnya tidak pernah sampai.', 'Sederhana, tapi mematikan.') and detailed 14–18 word contextual clauses.
voiceAndCadenceEngineering.breathPacing: Use comma and colon punctuation to introduce natural breath pauses, preventing monotonous TTS cadence.
voiceAndCadenceEngineering.phoneticBrackets: All regulatory, corporate, and historical acronyms must use phonetic bracket syntax: [BEI|B-E-I], [VOC|V-O-C], [PKPU|P-K-P-U], [UU|U-U].

antiSlopBlacklist: di era serba cepat / di era digital
scriptDifferentiation.endingDoctrine: Zero unearned moralizing or generic advice. Every script ends strictly on an unresolved forensic inquiry, an economic balance sheet reality, or an institutional consequence.

visualLayers.environment: Aged Papyrus Canvas with soft Batik Parang watermark and subtle warm-sunbeam vignette
visualLayers.exhibits: Torn-paper archival dockets, ancient manuscript scrolls, wax-sealed exhibits, sepia photographic cutouts
visualLayers.dynamicAnnotations: Red cinnabar wax stamps (RAHASIA, VERIFIED, VOID), hand-drawn ink underlines, amber highlighter callouts
visualLayers.dataBlocks: Parchment ledger tables, golden-ratio milestone timelines, TradingView minimal charts with antique gold strokes
visualLayers.typographyLayer: Plus Jakarta Sans & Serif headlines with sumi ink texture and frosted papyrus subtitle cards

suggestions.title: Anatomi Sindikat Scam Loker Kamboja & Pencucian Uang Kripto Rp 500 Triliun
suggestions.detail: Investigasi rantai rekrutmen lowongan kerja palsu di media sosial: penyelundupan pekerja migran ke kasino perbatasan dan perputaran USDT tanpa KYC.
suggestions.researchContext: Menelusuri aliran pencucian uang jaringan judi online dan penipuan asmara (pig butchering) berbasis di Sihanoukville dan Myawaddy. Data [PPATK|P-P-A-T-K] mencatat transaksi mencurigakan terkait sindikat ini menembus ratusan triliun rupiah melalui rekening nominee dan konversi stablecoin USDT di pasar P2P. Eksploitasi paspor turis dan transit di Bangkok untuk menghindari deteksi imigrasi.

suggestions.title: Krisis Likuiditas P2P Lending: Ratusan Miliar Dana Lender Nyangkut & Jeratan Asuransi Kredit
suggestions.detail: Mengapa janji imbal hasil 15-20% platform pinjol produktif berujung macet total? Menelusuri modus borrower fiktif dan wanprestasi asuransi kredit.
suggestions.researchContext: Analisis tingkat wanprestasi 90 hari ([TWP90|T-W-P-90]) di atas batas aman 5% pada platform P2P lending ternama seperti TaniFund dan Investree. Modus penggelemungan invoice pembiayaan modal kerja [UMKM|U-M-K-M], kegagalan klaim mitigasi risiko pada perusahaan asuransi penjamin, serta sanksi administratif pencabutan izin usaha oleh [OJK|O-J-K].

suggestions.title: Anatomi Phantom Billing RS & Kebocoran Dana JKN BPJS Kesehatan Ratusan Miliar
suggestions.detail: Temuan KPK atas manipulasi klaim fiktif (phantom billing) dan manipulasi diagnosis INA-CBGs di sejumlah rumah sakit swasta yang menggerus kas jaminan sosial.
suggestions.researchContext: Investigasi modus penggelembungan tagihan medis dalam sistem Indonesian Case Based Groups ([INA-CBGs|I-N-A-C-B-G-S]). Praktik rekayasa rekam medis pasien rawat inap fiktif, fisioterapi berulang yang tidak dilakukan, dan operasi katarak massal palsu di Sumatera Utara dan Jawa Tengah yang diungkap audit gabungan [KPK|K-P-K], [BPJS|B-P-J-S] Kesehatan, dan Kementerian Kesehatan.

suggestions.title: Ekonomi Gelap Calo Tiket Konser Jakarta: Bot Scripting, Orang Dalam, dan Margin 400%
suggestions.detail: Mengapa war tiket konser internasional di Jakarta selalu ludes dalam 60 detik? Anatomi perdagangan tiket sekunder dan sindikat jastip profesional.
suggestions.researchContext: Bedah teknis eksploitasi API platform ticketing (Loket, Tiket.com) menggunakan automation browser headless script dan proxy rotasi residensial. Markup harga tiket dari Rp 2,5 juta menjadi Rp 10-15 juta di marketplace sekunder (Viagogo, Twitter), persekongkolan alokasi tiket korporat dengan promotor, serta ketiadaan regulasi batas atas harga jual kembali di Indonesia.

suggestions.title: Perang Harga Nikel Global: Dampak Banjir Pasokan Smelter RKEF Indonesia ke Pasar Dunia
suggestions.detail: Banjir produksi Nickel Pig Iron (NPI) dari Morowali dan Weda Bay menekan harga nikel di London Metal Exchange (LME): berkah devisa atau jebakan komoditas?
suggestions.researchContext: Dinamika oversupply nikel dunia akibat akselerasi 40+ fasilitas smelter Rotary Kiln Electric Furnace (RKEF) di Sulawesi Tengah dan Maluku Utara. Harga nikel LME tertekan dari $30.000 menjadi $16.000 per ton, memicu penutupan tambang nikel berbiaya tinggi di Australia dan Kaledonia Baru. Ketergantungan pada batubara captive PLTU dan perdebatan penerapan pajak ekspor produk olahan berkadar nikel rendah.

suggestions.title: Misteri Cuci Mobil Hidrolik & Perputaran Uang Tunai di Jakarta
suggestions.detail: Investigasi di balik maraknya bisnis cuci mobil steam manual hidrolik pinggir jalan di Jakarta: bagaimana perputaran uang tunai harian tanpa jejak digital beroperasi.

suggestions.title: Anatomi Utang BUMN Karya & Restrukturisasi Finansial

suggestions.title: Ironi Impor Beras & Permainan Waktu Panen Raya Petani

suggestions.researchContext: Simulasi dampak kenaikan harga bahan bakar solar dan pertalite bersubsidi terhadap inflasi pangan pokok dan tarif angkutan ekspedisi logistik di jalan tol dan pelabuhan nasional.

suggestions.title: Investigasi Rantai Pasok: Bahan Baku Kritis & Ketergantungan Impor Monopolistik di Indonesia
suggestions.detail: Penelusuran mendalam mekanisme distorsi harga distributor tunggal dan dampaknya terhadap biaya pokok produksi industri hilir nasional.
suggestions.researchContext: Meneliti struktur pasar oligopoli pasokan bahan baku industri manufaktur di Jabodetabek dan Surabaya. Analisis margin perantara perdagangan besar, regulasi kuota Kementerian Perdagangan, dan beban biaya logistik antar-pulau.

suggestions.title: Anatomi Rente Ekonomi: Tata Kelola Izin Konsesi & Dampak Sistemik bagi Pelaku Usaha Lokal
suggestions.detail: Bedah regulasi transaksional dan bagaimana pembagian kuota terbatas menciptakan keuntungan abnormal bagi segelintir konglomerasi.
suggestions.researchContext: Pembongkaran ekonomi rente pemberian izin usaha pertambangan dan perkebunan di daerah. Bagaimana biaya kepatuhan regulasi formal dieksploitasi untuk menyingkirkan pelaku usaha kecil dan menciptakan barrier to entry.

suggestions.title: Forensik Perputaran Kas: Sistem Pembayaran Tunai & Transaksi Bayangan Perkotaan Jakarta
suggestions.detail: Menganalisis bagaimana perputaran uang tunai tanpa faktur elektronik bertahan di tengah penetrasi digitalisasi perbankan modern.
suggestions.researchContext: Studi sosiologis dan finansial pasar grosir Tanah Abang dan Mangga Dua. Aliran dana tunai tanpa sistem EDC perbankan, perputaran giro mundur, dan kalkulasi penghindaran pajak pertambahan nilai ([PPN|P-P-N]).
